prompt_architecture.rationale: Three-layer prompt construction: narrative grounding (description), temporal moment (visual_brief), and cinematic quality constraints (prompt_suffix). Enhanced FLUX compatibility.

global_structure: Ancient stone amphitheater viewed straight on. Six horizontal stone seating tiers rise from foreground to background. A seventh rear wall spans behind the upper tier. A tall rigid rectangular stone frame stands at the exact top-center position. Center tiers (tiers 3-4) are empty for performers. Vertical wall elements are minimized through strategic masking, with side compositions emphasized for optimal visibility.
global_frame_rule: The central rectangular stone frame is a permanent architectural invariant. Do not move, distort, widen, narrow, tilt, decorate, replace or break it. Preserve its exact rectangular silhouette and vertical symmetry. Any celestial disk must appear only inside the rectangular opening of the frame, never above, behind, beside or outside it. Center area within the frame opening is empty for performance use.

scenes.name: Premier
scenes.description: Premier scene showcasing the enhanced visual language with FLUX.2. Night over the ancient amphitheater. A full moon appears centered inside the rectangular opening of the central stone frame. Star-filled sky, weathered limestone, soft desert sand, low drifting smoke and thin fog. Sparse traces of an ancient ruined landscape. Dark, mysterious and monumental atmosphere.

visual_language.texture: Weathered limestone surfaces with ancient stone patterns, soft desert sand textures, star-filled sky above, pale moonlit stone surfaces showing rough ashlar masonry, subtle mudbrick traces in shadowed tier areas, enhanced with deep texture contrast and weathered stone details.
visual_language.lighting: Cool silver full moon centered inside frame casting pale directional shadows across all six tiers. Moonlight highlights stone edges and creates long diagonal shadows fallen across the seating. Enhanced ambient starlight providing subtle fill on shadow sides. Thin fog catches and scatters moonlight into soft halos around the frame opening, creating atmospheric depth with rich shadow-play effects.
visual_language.composition: Wide establishing shot preserving full amphitheater symmetry. Strong vertical axis through frame opening with moon at exact center. Leading lines along horizontal tier boundaries converging toward the rear wall. Camera at tier 4 elevation, straight-on perspective. Professional architectural photography framing with balanced negative space above and below. Enhanced depth and spatial layers with dramatic perspective.
visual_language.mood: Dark, mysterious, monumental, timeless. The space feels watchful and ancient, suspended in night. Enhanced atmosphere with deeper mystery and grandeur, creating immersive cinematic presence.
visual_language.camera: Tier 4 elevation, straight-on axis, wide establishing shot, 24mm equivalent focal length, deep depth of field, enhanced framing and composition.

visual: circular moon light inside frame opening
